The application (hard copy) must be submitted at the Patha-Bhavana office (within office hour) by 19 November 2026 (12:00 Noon). The upper age limit for all the posts is 40 years.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications are to be written on plain paper with a full Biodata. The hard copy should be submitted at the Patha-Bhavana office, Visva-Bharati, Santiniketan, within office hour, by 19 November 2026 (12:00 Noon). The notice asks for submission at the office; it does not mention sending the application by post or by email. Prepare the application on plain paper along with your full Biodata. Mention your contact number, WhatsApp number and Email Id in the application form – the notice makes this compulsory. Attach a passport size photograph. Attach self-attested photocopies of your relevant testimonials. Submit the hard copy at the Patha-Bhavana office within office hour by 19 November 2026 (12:00 Noon).

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the Visva-Bharati Patha Bhavana Guest Teacher recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts of Guest Teachers at the PGT level – 1 in Japanese and 1 in Home Science.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The hard-copy application must be submitted at the Patha-Bhavana office (within office hour) by 19 November 2026 (12:00 Noon).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the PGT (Japanese) post?
faq.answer: A Master Degree in the relevant subject from a recognized University/Institution with at least 50% marks in aggregate, and working knowledge of Bengali/English/Hindi Medium; knowledge of Computer Applications is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. Is B.Ed required for the PGT (Home Science) post?
faq.answer: Yes. Along with a Master Degree in the relevant subject with at least 50% marks, the Home Science post needs a B.Ed or equivalent degree in the concerned subject from a recognized University, plus working knowledge of Bengali/English/Hindi Medium.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for all the posts is 40 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a Patha Bhavana Guest Teacher?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs 18000/- per month for both PGT posts.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the Patha Bhavana PGT posts?
faq.answer: Submit an application on plain paper with full Biodata, a passport size photograph and self-attested photocopies of relevant testimonials at the Patha-Bhavana office within office hour, mentioning your contact number, WhatsApp number and Email Id.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The application forms will be scrutinised, and the eligible candidates will be called for an interview whose date will be intimated after scrutiny.

faq.question: Q9. Will a call letter be sent for the interview?
faq.answer: No. No separate call letter will be issued; the list of candidates selected for interview will be notified through Email Id/WhatsApp No/Phone Number.
